climate: COPY (SELECT ts,temp_avg,rh_avg,vpd_avg,dew_point,flow_gpm,water_total_gal,mister_water_today,outdoor_temp_f,outdoor_rh_pct FROM climate WHERE ts>='2026-09-04T20:30:00Z'::timestamptz AND ts<'2026-09-05T00:45:00Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY ts) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT CSV, HEADER TRUE)
controller_actions: COPY (SELECT ts,climate_action,priority_axis,moisture_assist_state,moisture_zone,wet_assist_allowed,wet_assist_block_reason,fog_allowed,fog_block_reason,temp_high_f,vpd_high_kpa,plan_id,relay_truth->>'fog' fog,relay_truth->>'mister_center' mister_center,relay_truth->>'fan1' fan1,relay_truth->>'fan2' fan2,relay_truth->>'vent' vent,source_system_state->>'greenhouse_state' greenhouse_state,source_system_state->>'mode_reason' mode_reason,source_system_state->>'vent_mist_assist_status' vent_mist_assist_status,source_system_state->>'moisture_block_reason' moisture_block_reason,source_system_state->>'direct_wet_zone_mask' direct_wet_zone_mask FROM climate_action_log WHERE ts>='2026-09-04T20:30:00Z'::timestamptz AND ts<'2026-09-05T00:45:00Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY ts) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT CSV, HEADER TRUE)
diagnostics: COPY (SELECT ts,firmware_version,uptime_s,reset_reason,controller_time_epoch,controller_local_hour,sntp_valid,sntp_miss_count,vent_mist_assist_active,zone_wet_granted FROM diagnostics WHERE ts>='2026-09-04T20:30:00Z'::timestamptz AND ts<'2026-09-05T00:45:00Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY ts) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT CSV, HEADER TRUE)
equipment_receipts: COPY (SELECT source_observed_through,source_connection_generation,source_sequence,gap_requested,gap_before,gap_reason,event_count,events_sha256,receipt_sha256 FROM equipment_state_source_receipts WHERE source_observed_through>='2026-09-04T20:30:00Z'::timestamptz AND source_observed_through<'2026-09-05T00:45:00Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY source_observed_through,source_sequence) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT CSV, HEADER TRUE)
equipment_state: COPY (SELECT ts,equipment,state FROM equipment_state WHERE ts>='2026-09-04T20:30:00Z'::timestamptz AND ts<'2026-09-05T00:45:00Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY ts,equipment) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT CSV, HEADER TRUE)
forecast_asof: COPY (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ts) ts,fetched_at,temp_f,rh_pct,vpd_kpa,wind_speed_mph,solar_w_m2 FROM weather_forecast WHERE ts>='2026-09-04T20:30:00Z'::timestamptz AND ts<'2026-09-05T00:45:00Z'::timestamptz AND fetched_at<=ts ORDER BY ts,fetched_at DESC) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT CSV, HEADER TRUE)
override_events: COPY (SELECT ts,override_type,mode FROM override_events WHERE ts>='2026-09-04T20:30:00Z'::timestamptz AND ts<'2026-09-05T00:45:00Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY ts,override_type) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT CSV, HEADER TRUE)
plan_delivery: COPY (SELECT delivered_at,event_type,event_label,resulting_plan_id,plan_written_at,acked_at,status,terminal_action,terminal_at,failure_class FROM plan_delivery_log WHERE delivered_at>='2026-09-04T20:30:00Z'::timestamptz AND delivered_at<'2026-09-05T00:45:00Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY delivered_at,id) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT CSV, HEADER TRUE)
setpoint_changes: COPY (SELECT ts,parameter,value,source,delivery_status,confirmed_at,expired_at FROM setpoint_changes WHERE ts>='2026-09-04T20:30:00Z'::timestamptz AND ts<'2026-09-05T00:45:00Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY ts,parameter) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT CSV, HEADER TRUE)
setpoint_snapshots: COPY (SELECT ts,parameter,value,zone FROM setpoint_snapshot WHERE ts>='2026-09-04T20:30:00Z'::timestamptz AND ts<'2026-09-05T00:45:00Z'::timestamptz AND parameter IN ('safety_max','safety_max_seal_margin_f','safety_vpd_max','mister_water_budget_gal','mister_daily_volume_max_gal','mister_max_runtime_min','sw_fog_closes_vent','sw_mister_closes_vent','sw_occupancy_inhibit','sw_direct_wet_stress_override_enabled','vpd_high','temp_high','fog_rh_ceiling_pct') ORDER BY ts,parameter,zone) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT CSV, HEADER TRUE)
system_state: COPY (SELECT ts,entity,value FROM system_state WHERE ts>='2026-09-04T20:30:00Z'::timestamptz AND ts<'2026-09-05T00:45:00Z'::timestamptz AND entity IN ('occupancy','occupancy_source','occupancy_timeout_reason','fog_block_reason','vent_mist_assist_status','climate_moisture_assist_state','climate_next_mist_eligible_s') ORDER BY ts,entity) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT CSV, HEADER TRUE)
water_meter_events: COPY (SELECT ts,source,meter_id,event_type,prior_total_gal,total_gal,delta_gal,quality_flag,prior_ts,attribution_class,attributed_scope,candidate_relays,attribution_quality FROM water_meter_events WHERE ts>='2026-09-04T20:30:00Z'::timestamptz AND ts<'2026-09-05T00:45:00Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY ts,id) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT CSV, HEADER TRUE)
